[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Straken''' served in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were tasked with delivering an arms shipment to allied forces on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="Mission" />
